sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
Biozombie Outbreak's core gameplay mechanics are centered around intense action and quick reflexes. Your goal is simple: survive as long as possible by shooting down hordes of zombies that come for you. Sounds easy, right? Well, it's not. The game requires lightning-fast reflexes, strategic thinking, and a keen eye for detail. With its intuitive controls, you can choose to play using your mouse, keyboard, or even touch controls, making it accessible to players of all skill levels.

One of the most interesting aspects of Biozombie Outbreak is its ability to adapt to your playing style. The game features a dynamic difficulty system that adjusts the difficulty level based on your performance. If you're doing well, the zombies will become tougher and more aggressive. If you're struggling, the game will ease up, giving you a chance to catch your breath and regroup.

As you progress through the levels, you'll encounter a range of challenges that will test your skills. From narrow alleyways to wide open streets, each environment offers a unique set of obstacles and opportunities. You'll need to use your wits to navigate these environments, using cover, corners, and other objects to stay alive.

But don't worry, we'll provide you with expert tips and tricks to help you overcome these challenges and emerge victorious. From basic gameplay mechanics to advanced strategies, we'll cover it all, so you can focus on what matters most: surviving the zombie apocalypse.
